newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - DnB sees lower 1998 Norway inflation.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - DnB sees lower 1998 Norway inflation.

text.p: Den norske Bank (DnB), Norway's biggest commercial bank, predicted on Wednesday that Norwegian inflation could fall below two percent in 1998 given the crown's strength.

DnB economist Herbert Kristoffersen said the forecast was based on the assumption that the Norwegian crown would continue to appreciate, and reach 95 points on the inverse ECU index at the end of this year.
The isolated effect of such an appreciation could reduce the 1998 consumer price index by 0.5 percentage points to below 2.0 percent, he told Reuters.
The crown, which on Wednesday hovered above 97 on the index, has firmed in recent months despite three cuts in official interest rates by the central bank.

The crown's appreciation should have a lesser impact on consumer prices this year, leading to a reduction of between 0.2 and 0.3 percentage points from previous forecasts of about 2.3 percent, Kristoffersen said.
